description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminQueue webpage in an online examination system. It manages session validation, database interactions related to course queues, and user navigation actions via button clicks and grid selection.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET webpage, handling course queue management and user navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes page; checks session variables, interacts with database to verify and possibly delete course queue entries.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Retransfers to the same page, possibly a placeholder for profile-related navigation.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by redirecting to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a grid row, storing selected student and course IDs in session variables, and navigates to ShowAns page.
